en:
- Fixed an issue where Truncheons were sometimes incorrectly recognized as melee weapons in the thrall Preferred Weapon selection logic.
- Global Weapon Stats and Spawn Unique Weapons now include throwing weapons and many other weapon subcategories that were previously missing from the list.
- Added a new Realm Dungeon setting: Thralls Allowed Inside. When enabled, thralls can enter Realm Dungeons. If disabled, any thralls entering the realm will be instantly removed from it and will stop following you. This allows admins to create thrall-free boss dungeons, for example. This setting is enabled by default and can be changed during Realm Creation or later in the realm's General Settings.
- Added a new Realm Dungeon setting: Pets Allowed Inside. When enabled, pets can enter Realm Dungeons. If disabled, any pets entering the realm will be instantly removed from it and will stop following you. This allows admins to create pet-free boss dungeons, for example. This setting is enabled by default and can be changed during Realm Creation or later in the realm's General Settings.
- Fixed an issue that prevented players with Editor permission from accessing Realm Settings, even though they were granted the required permissions.
- Fixed an issue that caused Thrall Stat Modifications to reset after a server restart, preventing previously applied stat changes from being retained.
- Fixed an issue that caused Pet Stat Modifications to reset after a server restart, preventing previously applied stat changes from being retained.
- Fixed an issue that caused Thralls to continue dragging NPCs after they had died, leaving the rope and dragging effect active.
- Fixed an issue that prevented Guarding and Scouting Thralls from receiving inactive XP for kills.
- Fixed several minor visual issues in the Classic Basement realm template.
- Fixed an issue in the Classic Basement realm template where changing the building piece style only affected part of the realm instead of the entire realm.
- Reworked the realm exit teleport system to attach teleport destinations directly to realms. This allows realm portals to be safely stacked inside other realms without causing teleport issues and also fixes problems that could result in infinite teleportation loops when exiting a realm.
- When browsing the realm list from within a realm, the realm you're currently in is no longer displayed. This reduces confusion and makes traveling between different realms more intuitive.
- Attempted to fix an issue that caused the Follower Party UI to reset to its default position after login.
- The item ban list now includes placeables and building pieces, allowing you to ban those as well.
- Fixed an issue that caused the Preferred Weapon Type section to be misaligned in the UI due to UI changes in the last base game update.
- Selecting an option in the emotes radial wheel (R) now closes the wheel correctly upon selection.

- Sửa lỗi Chỉnh chỉ số thrall bị đặt lại sau khi khởi động lại server.
- Sửa lỗi Chỉnh chỉ số thú cưng bị đặt lại sau khi khởi động lại server.

- Khi xem danh sách realm từ bên trong một realm, realm bạn đang ở không còn hiện nữa, giúp bớt nhầm lẫn và đi lại giữa các realm dễ hơn.

en:

- Fixed an issue that caused a client crash when approaching the Altar of the Fallen in rare cases.
- Fixed an issue that prevented Transportory Stones from being marked as your Favorite.
- Fixed an issue that caused opened portals to lead to the nearest Transportory Stone instead of your Favorite.
- Fixed a critical issue that allowed players to search containers they did not have access to.
- Fixed an issue that allowed players to invite someone to a party while the target player was still loading. Players who are currently loading or teleporting can no longer be invited to parties.
- Fixed several compiler warnings.

- Sửa lỗi cổng mở ra dẫn tới Đá Dịch Chuyển gần nhất thay vì đá Yêu thích.
- Sửa lỗi nghiêm trọng cho phép người chơi tìm trong rương họ không có quyền.
- Sửa lỗi cho phép mời người khác vào party khi họ còn đang tải. Người chơi đang tải hoặc dịch chuyển không còn bị mời vào party được.
- Sửa một số cảnh báo của trình biên dịch.

en:
- Fixed an issue where admins were removed from Realms upon login if Realm visiting was disabled.
- Improved movement detection for lever platforms in Flooded Ruins and Pleasure Grove.
- Fixed an issue where assigned groups were not being saved in the Thrall Management UI.
- Fixed an issue that prevented the Heart Extraction recipe from appearing in the Heart Extractor.
- Fixed an issue where created Unique Weapons lost their extra buffs after logging in or restarting the server.
- Fixed an issue where modified Global Weapons lost their extra buffs after logging in or restarting the server.
- Fixed missing Decal Components on the Altar of the Fallen function selector stones after the UE5 migration.
- Fixed missing textures on the Heart Extractor models.
- Removed the Pull Construction Materials setting, as this functionality is now available in the base game.
- Removed the Pull Crafting Materials setting, as this functionality is now available in the base game.
- Completely reworked the Unique Weapon Spawn system.
- Completely reworked the Unique Armor Spawn system.
- Completely reworked the Pet Stat Modifier system.
- Completely reworked the Thrall Stat Modifier system.
- Reworked the entire mod UI for a cleaner and more modern experience.
- Reworked the Party system for both players and followers at the code level for improved reliability and maintainability.
- Redesigned the Party UI.
- Party UI positions are now automatically recalculated when the game window is resized to maintain proper placement (can be disabled in User Settings).
- Party UI now automatically hides whenever a full-screen interface (such as the inventory) is open or when the HUD is hidden (e.g. Ctrl + Z), matching the behavior of the base game's HUD elements.
- Reworked the mod's key binding system. Any function can now be assigned to any key independently.
- Reworked the Item, Feat, and Recipe ID system. All IDs now use the 19990000–19999999 range, significantly reducing conflicts with other mods and future base game content.
- Reworked the entire Guide system with more detailed explanations and additional images.
- Reworked the Mailbox system by merging Private Mailbox and Public Mailbox into a single Mailbox with all functionality included.
- Changed the Fortress of Souls material to give it a more icy appearance.
- Replaced Realm lighting with UE5 Lumen lighting.
- Improved admin settings save performance.
- Significantly improved admin setting descriptions, especially for the Pet and Thrall Stat Modifiers, with detailed explanations and formulas.
- Changed how the Global Weapon Stat Modifier works. Instead of replacing values, it now adds or subtracts values based on the configured modifiers.
- Changed how the Global Armor Stat Modifier works. Instead of replacing values, it now adds or subtracts values based on the configured modifiers.
- Improved the Fast Deposit system. It now reports how many items were deposited or informs you if no matching items were found.
- Greatly improved Realm performance, eliminating the heavy FPS drops previously experienced in large and complex Realms, especially on lower-end PCs.
- Fixed numerous Realm-related issues.
- Realm templates can now be created without a fixed sky or the black box, allowing for greater flexibility when designing custom templates.
- Distant proxies are now hidden when entering a realm and re-enabled upon leaving it, making players feel as though they are truly outside the main map, in the middle of nowhere.
- Fixed an issue that prevented the Classic Realm from switching to the selected size.
- Fixed weather-related issues in Realm templates that allow players to change the weather.
- Fixed a synchronization issue with the platform lever in The Pleasure Grove (L) and improved the overall stability of the transport system.
- Admin and User Settings now display tooltip descriptions at the correct size across all screen resolutions.

- Thay ánh sáng Realm bằng ánh sáng UE5 Lumen.

- Cải thiện mạnh hiệu năng Realm, loại bỏ tình trạng tụt FPS nặng trước đây ở Realm lớn và phức tạp, nhất là trên máy cấu hình thấp.

- Các vật thể ở xa giờ bị ẩn khi vào realm và hiện lại khi rời đi, khiến người chơi cảm thấy thật sự ở ngoài bản đồ chính, giữa hư không.

- Sửa lỗi thời tiết ở các mẫu Realm cho phép người chơi đổi thời tiết.
- Sửa lỗi đồng bộ cần gạt bệ ở The Pleasure Grove (L) và cải thiện độ ổn định chung của hệ thống di chuyển.
